127029378.description:
Roll the dice, build your deck, strategize, create and break alliances, and snatch victory from the jaws of defeat as you spend the week playing a variety of tabletop games! We will provide a wide variety of games, but participants are welcome to bring in their own. See you at the table!

For Ages 10-13

Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm

Dates: June 22-26

Location: Burton Community Center
Backup Location: Dr. Wesley Grant Sr. Southside Center

Contact: Nate Van Patten, nvanpatten@ashevillenc.gov, 828-417-1585
